The West Bengal Panchayat (Constitution) Rules, 1975
The Sub-divisional Officer shall keep the papers in
safe custody for three months after which they may
be destroyed.
CHAPTER VIII
Election of Karmadhyaksha of Sthayee Samiti of
Panchayat Samiti
9. (1) Within one week from the 1[date of completion of
elections of all the members] of Sthayee Samiti
under clause (b) of sub-section (2) of section 124
2[or within such further time as may be allowed
by the District Panchayat Election Officer for
reasons to be recorded by him in this behalf] the
Sub-divisional Officer shall call a meeting of
the members of each Sthayee Samiti other than
members appointed under clause (c) of sub-section
(2) of that section by fixing a date, place and time
and by causing a notice thereof in Form 1 to be
served on each member of the Sthayee Samiti at
least 3[Seven] days before the date fixed for the
election of a Karmadhyaksha .
(2) The election meeting shall be presided over by an
officer not below the rank of 4[group A officer] as
may be authorised by the Sub-divisional Officer in
Form 2. Such officer shall not be entitled to vote at
the election.
(3) The election of the Karmadhyaksha of the Sthayee
Samiti shall be conducted in the same manner as
laid down under 5[sub-rules (3), (6) and (7)] of rule
3 as far as applicable :
6[Provided that not less than one-half of total
number of elected members] of the Sthayee Samiti
shall form a quorum for the meeting :
7[Provided further that] no quorum is necessary
in an adjourned meeting.
1 Subs. by ibid, for “date of the election of members.”
2 Subs. by Notification No. 141/Panch, dated 11.1.79
3 Subs. by Notification No. 16778/Panch, dated 21.1.78
4 Subs. by Notification No. 121-PN/O/I, dated 13.1.95.
5 Subs. by ibid.
6 Subs. by Notification No. 847/PN/O/I, dated 12.3.98, for “provided that one
half of the total number of members.”
7 Subs. by ibid, “provided that.”
